US Pauses Military Strikes on Iran Amid Diplomacy and Sanctions Focus

The United States has paused military strikes against Iran for at least two days, following a period of escalated actions. Reports indicate the pause is linked to diplomatic efforts and concerns over missile stockpiles. US officials believe economic pressure through sanctions, rather than military action, is a more effective strategy to compel Iran's compliance amid ongoing tensions. Iran, however, has stated there are currently no negotiations with the US. The situation involves significant economic pressure on Iran, including sanctions and blockades, contributing to an economic crisis.
